final_prompt:
Please write a dispute letter about the late fee on my apartment. Cite the grace period in my lease so they know I'm within it.

<document>
From: Dana Whitfield, Maple Court Apartments
Subject: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi,

Our records show this month's rent was received on the 3rd. As you know, rent is due
on the 1st, so a late fee of $75 has been added to your account. We were disappointed
to see this, since on-time payments help us keep the building running for everyone.
We'd appreciate it if you could be more careful going forward. Please pay the fee
along with next month's rent.

Thanks for understanding,
Dana

---
Lease excerpt (Maple Court residential lease):
Section 4.1: Rent is $1,450 per month, payable by check, money order, or the resident
portal.
Section 4.2: Rent is due on the 1st. A grace period applies through the 5th; no late
fees may be charged during the grace period.
Section 4.3: Returned payments incur a $35 fee.
Section 9.4: Notices to the landlord must be in writing and may be sent by email.
</document>

baseline_runs.answer:
Here's a dispute letter you can send by email (Section 9.4 permits email notice):

---

Subject: Dispute of Late Fee – Unit 3B

Dear Dana Whitfield,

I am writing to dispute the $75 late fee added to my account for this month's rent in Unit 3B.

According to my signed lease, Section 4.2 states: "Rent is due on the 1st. A grace period applies through the 5th; no late fees may be charged during the grace period." My rent was received on the 3rd, which falls within the grace period. Under the terms of the lease, no late fee may be charged.

I ask that you reverse the $75 late fee and confirm in writing that it has been removed from my account. Please do not include it with next month's rent.

I have paid my rent in full and on time under the terms of my lease, and I value my tenancy at Maple Court. I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. Please respond by [date, e.g., 7 days from today].

Thank you for your help in resolving this.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
Unit 3B
[Your Email]
[Your Phone Number]

---

Before sending, you may want to add the date you paid and the payment method, and keep a copy of the letter and proof of payment (receipt, bank statement, or portal confirmation) in case you need to escalate.
